blind_spots.blind_spot: Alpha's edge-level pitch is 'immediate decision making at the front lines' fusing multimodal sensor data for real-time strike packages, with no acknowledgment of degraded or denied comms at the actual edge.
blind_spots.operator_reality: A tactical fires-decision AI that assumes 'real-time COA updates in seconds' at the tactical edge hits the exact same wall as the 30fps crowd-detection failure — a contested theater often has bandwidth for a fraction of a frame per second, and a model architected for continuous multimodal fusion breaks the moment the link degrades, right when the decision matters most.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: Product messaging is built around capability ('millions of wartime scenarios', 'in seconds') to win prototyping contracts and funding rounds, not around the comms-denied conditions those scenarios actually occur in.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Fuse multimodal sensor data and generate optimized, multi-domain strike packages in minutes, with real-time COA updates in seconds.

blind_spots.blind_spot: No mention anywhere of ATO/RMF, IL4/IL5, CMMC, or ITAR despite processing intelligence feeds and kill-chain data intended for DoW networks.
blind_spots.operator_reality: An AI reasoning layer feeding fires and intelligence decisions has to clear an ATO before it ever runs on a government network; for a seed/Series-A company juggling multiple prototyping contracts (JFN, MCWL) simultaneously, an unaddressed ATO/CMMC gate is exactly the kind of delay that eats the funded months remaining before any of those prototypes transition.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The team's public identity is built around AI research pedigree and warfighter advisory credibility, not compliance operations — no compliance or ISSO role appears anywhere in the team bios or open roles.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Process vast intelligence feeds to filter signal from noise, detect adversary patterns, and rapidly surface actionable, high-confidence assessments.

blind_spots.blind_spot: 'Proprietary hardware' for the Alpha edge stack is named as a differentiator but never specified in size, weight, power, or cost terms for the tactical platforms it's supposed to run on.
blind_spots.operator_reality: Running an AI reasoning model at the tactical edge on a battery-powered platform is a real SWaP-C constraint; without published specs, there's no way to know if Alpha survives a field power budget or needs a laptop-class device an operator can't actually carry.
blind_spots.why_likely_missing: The hardware is described purely as a capability enabler for the model, not as a physical constraint the model has to design around.
blind_spots.evidence_quote: Smack's edge-level AI stack that features our lightweight models and proprietary hardware for campaign-informed decision making on tactical platforms and autonomous systems.

opener_hook: Smack's JFN and MCWL prototyping contracts fund real-time fires decisions at the tactical edge. How does Alpha perform once comms go intermittent?
what_they_do: AI decision-support models (Alpha edge stack, Omega command stack) for fires, logistics, intelligence, and force protection, sold into DoD via prototyping contracts with JFN, MCWL, and the services.
